Package com.codeup.novabook.jdbc

Interface RowMapper<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of object that this mapper produces
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface RowMapper<T>
Functional interface for mapping database result set rows to domain objects.

This interface defines a contract for converting ResultSet rows into domain objects. It's used in conjunction with JdbcTemplateLight to provide type-safe database query results.

Example usage:


 RowMapper<User> userMapper = rs -> {
     User user = new User(
         rs.getString("name"),
         rs.getString("email"),
         rs.getString("password"),
         rs.getString("phone")
     );
     user.setId(rs.getObject("id", UUID.class));
     return user;
 };
 
 List<User> users = jdbcTemplate.query("SELECT * FROM users", null, userMapper);

  • Method Details

    • map

      T map(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException
      Maps a single row of the ResultSet to an object of type T.

      This method is called for each row in the result set. The ResultSet is positioned at the current row when this method is called.

      Parameters:
      rs - the ResultSet positioned at the current row
      Returns:
      an object of type T representing the current row
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the column labels/indices are invalid
